title: Normalize required regular record rule
objective: Make Sunday OFF and holiday LBR/LIBUR require a Millware regular PR_TASKREGLN record everywhere sync status is computed.
steps: Inspect current diffs for target files before editing.
Introduce or reuse a helper that returns false only for ALFA and N/A regular attendance requirements.
Apply the rule in backend comparison and frontend comparison UI paths.
Keep overtime requirement separate: OT record required only when Venus OT > 0.
acceptance: OFF is not excluded from regular Millware requirement.
LBR/LIBUR are treated as requiring regular Millware data.
